about: Everything that puts something on the screen, by what sets it off, and who decides: a rule on the Mac, the brain, or the board itself. A number names the code that keeps it (charactergen reads its value there), and a brain's wake comes from the transcript view's own table.

deciders.label: Mac rule
deciders.about: The Mac's core, at once and the same every time: the look, needs you, the tags, the work stream and the rules' own reactions.

deciders.label: Brain
deciders.about: Jev, a moment later or not at all: the mood, and every reaction it picks (a face, a finish, a sign, what it says).

deciders.label: Board
deciders.about: The firmware, by itself: what a touch or a shake is, the queue, which variation plays, busy and frantic, and the screen with no Mac.

brain.about: Asked about one event at a time, the highest wake first and the oldest of those, and never one an event with a wake of its own came after. Each pass asks every question at once and the outputs act on the answers: the mood moves, a reaction is sent. Nothing is asked while something needs you, but what you say to it.

numbers.what: an event is answered only within
numbers.name: maxWaitMs

numbers.what: a reaction counts as playing for at most
numbers.name: openForMs

numbers.what: it speaks only when sure of the words to
numbers.name: sayFloor

numbers.what: buddies answer each other at most
numbers.name: maxRepliesInARow

layers.label: No Mac
layers.about: From power-on until the first state, and again when no state comes for this long. Over everything: no voice, no sign, the work stream gone.

numbers.what: the Mac says its state again every
numbers.name: keepaliveMs

layers.label: Listening
layers.about: While you hold the button to talk, and until the reply or the wait runs out. Plays even over needs you, and drops every reaction waiting.

layers.label: Needs you
layers.about: While an agent waits on you. Cuts the reaction playing, stops the voice and the work stream, and holds the face: taps only dip it and nothing else plays.

layers.label: A reaction
layers.about: One at a time, over the look: the queue on the board decides when each plays. A brain's reaction waits its turn; a rule's plays only if nothing busy is playing; a tap or a gesture cuts what plays.

numbers.what: a brain's reaction gives up after waiting
numbers.name: reactionTTL

layers.label: The look
layers.about: Underneath everything: asleep with no sessions, idle with sessions resting, else what the latest working agent is doing. Every look is drawn in the mood, and the board picks its variation and dresses it for the tags.

groups.label: Your agents
groups.about: What Claude Code and Codex do, from their hooks.

rows.when: A session starts, resumes, or has its context compacted
rows.does: Plays starting if nothing busy is playing. The work stream compacts its words on a compaction.

brain.note: Only a compaction has a line.

rows.when: You send an agent a prompt: a turn starts
rows.does: Plays starting if nothing busy is playing. The brain waits for the prompt's reading (You, below).

brain.note: Held until its prompt's reading comes.

rows.when: An agent is working
rows.does: The look is what the agent with the latest event is doing: tests, a helper, the shell, the web, reading, a tool, planning. A busier activity shows at once, a quieter one only after it has held. A session with nothing for an hour no longer counts as working.

rows.when: A tool runs quietly for a while
rows.does: The tool's activity turns to waiting: nothing is asked of you. A Codex request shows as waiting for its first moments too.

rows.when: Several agents work at once
rows.does: The board makes its own busy and frantic tags from how many work: the working looks play quicker, and busier designs come up.

rows.when: A turn runs long
rows.does: The Mac adds the tier the agents' working stretch has reached, tier1 to tier5 (a quick reply carries the stretch on); the gel settles into the tier's calm base, puts out its kit (headphones it puts on first) and plays the tier's pastimes, after a rest, the newest tier's most often, a move (the coffee reach, the melt, the stretch break) never soon after the last; both faces stretch from tier4.

rows.when: Each tool call (the work stream)
rows.does: The call's word falls past the face. The Mac picks one at a time to come forward as a gag: a turn's first call, a check starting, a helper, a big edit, a combo, a failure's bonk, a check's PASS or FAIL, the turn's end (gathered, buried, frozen, dropped). The board draws the rest. The brain hears only the bonks and timeouts, on its next line.

rows.when: A tool call fails
rows.does: No card: the failed call's word hits Boop in the work stream, harder for each failure within two minutes (bonk, bonk again, a helmet, throwing it back). A denial, a timeout and a lookup that found nothing have gags of their own. The third and fourth failures wake the brain, which may grunt or swear in its face; a stray one is only a bonk.

brain.note: The ladder's third and fourth rungs, a check failing, or passing after failing, have a line, unless the personality hears every tool.

rows.when: Tests, a build or a deploy pass or fail
rows.does: The work stream shows PASS or FAIL. The brain may react with a face and words; a check passing after failing is a big one.

brain.note: A check failing, again, or passing after failing.

rows.when: A helper agent starts, or comes back
rows.does: Delegating while it works; helper_return when it's back, if nothing busy is playing. The work stream says helper, then done, each landing as a word does.

rows.when: An agent needs your approval or answer
rows.does: Shows who's asking, the oldest first and how many more, until you answer, dismiss it, its agent's process ends, or nothing comes for long enough. The brain is held, but for push-to-talk.

brain.note: Its start never does; your answer does, if work goes on.

rows.when: A turn finishes
rows.does: Only the brain plays a finish: success, failure, a reply, or nothing, read from the agent's last message. The work stream gathers its words, or buries them (context full), freezes them (rate limit) or drops them (failed).

brain.note: Waits for the last message's reading.

rows.when: A turn is interrupted
rows.does: Plays stopped if nothing busy is playing; the work stream drops its words. The brain hears the finish as stopped.

rows.when: An agent's process ends
rows.does: Its needs you clears and the session rests. No reaction plays.

rows.when: No agent works, or none is open
rows.does: Idle while sessions are open, asleep with none at all. A session silent for a day is forgotten.

rows.when: Agents rest a while
rows.does: The Mac adds the tier their rest has reached, tier1 to tier5, the same ladder as work's; the gel plays the tier's pastimes (a bubble, a book, a tower, counting sheep), grows its plant from tier3, and nods off at tier5.

groups.label: You, at the Mac
groups.about: What you write and say, and whether you're there.

rows.when: Your prompt, read on the Mac
rows.does: Scrubbed and read where it's typed: its kind, tone and length, the buddies' names in it, and up to three of its phrases. The brain may react with a face, hold up a sign with your words, or notice when you said its name. A long read or docs puts glasses on for the turn (the reading tag).

rows.when: You hold the button and talk to it
rows.does: The board listens at once (BOOT held, or the app's mic button); what the Mac heard goes to the brain, the one thing it answers while something needs you. Its reaction is the reply: what you meant, answered with a face, the reply's move on the gel, a sound or a word, and a sign, for a question about the agents what they're really doing.

rows.when: You come back to the Mac after a break
rows.does: The brain may stretch and wake up for you after a long break. Going away shows nothing.

rows.when: Agents' work adds up
rows.does: Each tool, helper and finished turn adds to its growth. A stage reached adds the stage's tag for good, and a party for the rest of the day, which starts with the confetti and a sign saying what it grew into (I'm a Sprout!), waiting its turn. The popover says why it wears the hat.

rows.when: Its first launch
rows.does: Onboarding plays the brain's finishes itself: the found board beckons, holding up "Tap me!", wakes when it's paired, and celebrates at the end.

groups.label: Your hand on the board
groups.about: What you do to the board itself, which it answers at once and tells the Mac about.

rows.when: You tap the screen
rows.does: Poked, then tap spam from a few taps in a row. While needs you shows, the tap opens the waiting thread on the Mac instead; on a finish that names a thread, that thread. The brain hears the run of pokes, and lets the rest of a run go once it's reacting to it.

numbers.what: the Mac counts in a row within
numbers.name: inARowMs

numbers.what: the brain lets a run go from poke
numbers.name: answersRunFrom

rows.when: You stroke it, ruffle it, boop its nose, tickle it, shake it, pick it up, put it down, or thump the desk
rows.does: The board's own reaction, one loop, cutting what plays; skipped while the face is held. The brain hears what you did.

rows.when: You turn it face down, and up again
rows.does: Face down it dims, hushes and refuses every reaction but listening, and the brain is held. Face up it plays peekaboo.

brain.note: Held from face down until peekaboo.

rows.when: You press BOOT
rows.does: With someone in line it plays the hand-off and the Mac opens the next agent: waiting on you first, then dismissed, then resting. Presses close together walk down the line. With no one, it's a tap.

rows.when: You hold a finger on the needs-you screen
rows.does: Dismisses that request: the Mac drops it from the screen and the session counts as resting, though the agent still waits.

groups.label: Time passing
groups.about: What comes with no event at all.

rows.when: A stretch of work with no reaction
rows.does: The brain checks in on the turn, and may react: its personality says how often, and quiet or chatty talk may say otherwise. A reaction starts the wait again.

rows.when: A quiet stretch with agents open
rows.does: The brain checks in while you're here and something happened lately, at its personality's pace or its talk's; else once an hour.

rows.when: The time of day, the weekday, a holiday, a milestone day
rows.does: The Mac sends the day's tags; the board dresses for them (a nightcap, shades on Friday, a witch's hat, snow) and picks the designs that need them. On a day with an occasion, the first agent's event of a launch wakes it holding up the day's sign (Happy Halloween!, Day 50!). The popover says why it's dressed as it is. The brain hears the day in NOW's heading.

rows.when: Any pass of the brain
rows.does: The brain may move the mood to a neighbour on the pack's map (Moods). Every look is drawn in it at once. A mood fades only as its steering says; no timer does it.

rows.when: The first pass of a new day
rows.does: The brain picks yesterday's diary line. Nothing shows on the board; the popover keeps a week.
